description: Component for micro-batch SQL Server CDC via `cdc.fn_cdc_get_all_changes_*`.

outputs.description: Sensor run requests carrying a batch of insert/update/delete row changes

username.label: Username
username.description: SQL Server login with db_owner (or equivalent SELECT + cdc-role) on `database`

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the SQL Server password

driver.label: Driver
driver.description: 'pymssql' (pure Python, default) or 'pyodbc' (requires ODBC Driver 18 installed) -- matches mssql_resource's convention.

encrypt.label: Encrypt
encrypt.description: Enable connection encryption. Required for Azure SQL.

trust_server_certificate.label: Trust Server Certificate
trust_server_certificate.description: When True, skip server-cert verification. Use only for self-signed local SQL Server.

database.label: Database
database.description: Which SQL Server database to track. CDC must already be enabled on it (sys.sp_cdc_enable_db).

table_patterns.label: Table Patterns
table_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns matched against 'schema.table' (e.g. 'dbo.orders', 'dbo.order_items_*'). Resolved against cdc.change_tables + sys.schemas/sys.tables at the start of every tick (not cached) -- a newly CDC-enabled table matching a wildcard is picked up automatically on its next tick, no restart required. A table can resolve to more than one capture instance (e.g. mid-migration); all matching instances for a matched table are queried.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger when changes are detected

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations

max_events_per_tick.label: Max Events Per Tick
max_events_per_tick.description: Caps how many row-change events this sensor processes in one tick, even if more remain before it would otherwise report 'caught up'. Unset (default): no cap. When the cap is hit, position is persisted only through the last event actually processed -- the remainder is picked up on the next tick.

on_first_run.label: On First Run
on_first_run.description: 'start_now' (default) -- skip all historical CDC data and start capturing changes from the server's CURRENT max LSN on the very first tick. Pair with a separate one-time snapshot/full-load of existing rows -- this sensor is the ongoing-changes half of a CDC pipeline, not an initial-load mechanism. 'from_beginning' -- start from the OLDEST LSN any tracked capture instance still retains (the minimum of each matched instance's own sys.fn_cdc_get_min_lsn). Rarely useful outside small/test databases with long CDC retention.

op_name.label: Op Name
op_name.description: Op name to key the run_config under. Emitted as `{'ops': {op_name: {'config': {...}}}}`. Defaults to 'config' for backward compat with other sensors in this registry; set to the real op/asset name if it's not literally 'config'.

source_asset_key.label: Source Asset Key
source_asset_key.description: Optional asset key to receive an AssetObservation on every tick that yields changes. Metadata includes database, tables, event_count, inserts, updates, deletes, from_lsn, to_lsn.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Default status of the sensor (running or stopped)

emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
emit_materialization.description: When True (default), emit AssetMaterialization on the target asset key. External assets show healthy/green in the Dagster UI and downstream AutomationCondition.eager() fires naturally on parent updates. When False, emit AssetObservation -- free of Dagster+ credit charges, but downstream conditions that gate on ~any_deps_missing() (including eager()) will not fire.
